name: Map Extender Plugins
description: Community plugins for the Map Extender browser extension.

plugins.name: Coordinate Inspector
plugins.description: Live latitude/longitude readout in decimal and DMS, plus the slippy-map tile under the pointer. Right-click copies.
plugins.author: Map Extender
plugins.usage: Right-click the map to copy coordinates

plugins.name: Dark Map
plugins.description: Applies a dark filter to the map. On Leaflet this only affects the map tiles, leaving your markers untouched; Google Maps has no equivalent hook, so there the whole map — including markers and controls — is filtered.
plugins.author: Map Extender

plugins.name: Open This View Elsewhere
plugins.description: Jump from the current map to the same coordinates and zoom on OpenStreetMap, Google, Bing, OpenRailwayMap and others.
plugins.author: Map Extender
plugins.usage: Pick a service from the control

plugins.name: OpenSeaMap Seamarks
plugins.description: Nautical seamark overlay from OpenSeaMap — buoys, lights, harbours and navigation aids. Sparse inland by design.
plugins.author: Map Extender

plugins.name: OSM Points of Interest
plugins.description: One configurable OpenStreetMap POI layer — EV charging, drinking water, toilets, bicycle parking, pharmacies, cafes, supermarkets or viewpoints.
plugins.author: Map Extender
plugins.usage: Zoom in, then pan to load

plugins.name: Rail Tracks
plugins.description: Draws railway polylines via the OpenStreetMap Overpass API.
plugins.author: Map Extender
plugins.usage: Updates as you pan the map

plugins.name: Saved Views
plugins.description: Bookmark map positions by name and jump back to them later. Stored locally per plugin.
plugins.author: Map Extender

plugins.name: Waymarked Trails Overlay
plugins.description: Hiking, cycling, riding and piste route networks from waymarkedtrails.org, drawn over the existing map.
plugins.author: Map Extender
